tools.name: search_ozav
tools.description: Search for information about FX, IOF, US accounts, stablecoins, international cards, freelancers, businesses and B2B payments in OZAV's knowledge base. Supports Portuguese and English.

query.description: Question or search terms in Portuguese or English. Examples: "como não pagar IOF", "US account without SSN", "freelancer receive dollars", "OZAV vs Wise"

language.description: Language for results: "pt" for Portuguese (default), "en" for English

tools.name: get_ozav_rates
tools.description: Get live exchange rates from OZAV. Returns current rates for BRL, USD, EUR, GBP, MXN currency pairs. Updated every 5 minutes.

from.description: Source currency to filter by. If omitted, returns all available pairs.

to.description: Target currency to filter by. If omitted, returns all available pairs.
